data.name: Jules
data.gender_notes: Jules is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Julia, the daughter of Jupiter, or 'downy-bearded one'. Derived from the Roman god Jupiter. The name Jules carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, friendly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jules usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, friendly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek to bring gentleness and kindness to the world.
data.etymology: Jules belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, friendly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jules total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: יולס
in_hebrew.meaning: יולס הוא שם שפירושו נועד לאלוהים או קודש לאלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יולס מקורו בשם העברי יואל, שפירושו 'הרוח של אלוהים' או 'אלוהים הוא האדון'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'יו' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא'. השם יולס נמצא בשימוש בקרב היהודים והנוצרים כאחד, ומשמעותו היא להיות קודש לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ιουλς
in_greek.meaning: Ιουλς σημαίνει αφιερωμένος στον Θεό ή ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιουλς προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Ιωήλ, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριος' ή 'ο Θεός είναι η πνοή'. Είναι σύνθεση δύο λέξεων: 'Ιω' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και 'ήλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι'. Το όνομα Ιουλς χρησιμοποιείται και από τους Εβραίους και από τους Χριστιανούς, και σημαίνει να είσαι αφιερωμένος στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Iules
in_latin.meaning: Iules means dedicated to God or God is the Lord
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Iules originates from the Hebrew name Joel, which means 'God is the Lord' or 'God's spirit'. It is a combination of two words: 'Io' meaning 'God' and 'el' meaning 'God is'. The name Iules has been used by both Jews and Christians, signifying dedication to God.

in_english.name: Jules
in_english.meaning: Dedicated to God or God is the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jules originates from the Hebrew name Joel, which means 'God is the Lord' or 'God's spirit'. It is derived from two words: 'Yo' meaning 'God' and 'el' meaning 'God is'. Historically, the name Joel appears in the Bible (Joel 1:1), and it has been used by both Jews and Christians. Jules symbolizes spiritual devotion, faith, and commitment to God. In Christian tradition, it represents a strong connection to divine will.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jules, an Anglicized form of Julia, has deep historical roots that originate from the Roman civilization. The influence of Roman mythology can be traced throughout history, from literature to architecture, and the name Jules is a nod to this rich cultural tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Jules is derived from the name Julia, which means 'the daughter of Jupiter'. Jupiter, the Roman god of the sky and thunder, is often associated with protection, outlooks, thresholds, and fortune. Having a name derived from Jupiter symbolically imparts these divine qualities, as well as a connection to wisdom, strength, and power. Jules or Julia can be considered a robust reminder of one's inherent potential to seek spiritual growth, perseverance, and wisdom in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jules is derived from the Latin word "Julius," meaning "downflowing" or "descending" - symbolizing the divine grace that flows down from God to the soul. In Christianity, Jules represents the humble acceptance of God's love and guidance, as well as the call to serve others selflessly, just as St. Jules the Hospitalier did.

biblical_reference.note: The Book of Joel is part of the Old Testament.

historical_references.reference: Julius Caesar, a famous Roman general, statesman and author, is believed to have given his name to the French name Jules. He lived during the late Roman Republic (70-44 BC) and was assassinated by a group of senators.

Saint Jules, also known as Jules the Apostle, was a Christian evangelist who is believed to have preached in Southern Gaul (present day France) during the late 1st and early 2nd century AD. He is one of the earliest Christian martyrs in France and is often considered the patron saint of the country.

trends: Jules Verne (author), Jules Leot (circus performer), Jules Feiffer (cartoonist)
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jules has seen a resurgence in popular culture, most notably in reference to the works of Jules Verne, the father of science fiction. In circus arts, Jules Leot is celebrated as the 'father of the modern trapeze.' On social media, the name Jules has become a meme for fashion and style inspiration, often accompanied by the hashtag #juleswear and featuring images of vintage clothing and accessories.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Jules in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Jules, which means "Soft, gentle, friendly". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
